key_findings: Trigeminal neuropathy (ION-CCI) in male rats impairs decision-making and reduces BLA-ACC theta synchrony.
ION-CCI reduces ACC MBP, NG2+ OPCs and CC1+ oligodendrocytes and increases microglial activation and IL-1β in the ACC.
